subject: tryCatch block does not work with reduce expression

messages.author: c604b89d9c6ef07d
messages.subject: tryCatch block does not work with reduce expression
parts:
Hi,
I was trying to handle generated by the reduce expression in my code.
For this purpose what i did

in the reduce part of reduce expression i delibrately written the
wrong code.

Example: reduce<-expression{

pre={count=0;},
reduce={ total.sum=sum(reduce.values,count),
post= { rhcollect(reduce.keys,total.sum)}
}

If i run it normally then before submitting the job only error is
thrown because the sum function does not expect list.

To handle this exception i have used the tryCatch block inside the
reduce expression.
But it throws that syntax error around the commas after pre and
reduce.

Well i removed the commas and then job gets submitted and to my
surprise it gets succeeded as well. When i saw the output there was
mapper output only, not the reducer part. The reduce expression was
not run only.

Is this a Bug?
Is this tryCatch block can handle every kind of exceptions?

Regards,
Shekhar

messages.subject: Re: tryCatch block does not work with reduce expression
parts:
This is the reduce expression. On running it gives the syntax error on
the commas after pre and reduce construct.
When i remove the commas, it doesn't execute at all.

The sum function in the reduce construct will throw exception, since
sum function expect the vector instead of list.

r <- expression(
tryCatch({
pre={ count=0 },
reduce={ count<-sum(reduce.values,count) },
post={ rhcollect(reduce.key,count) }
},
Error=function(e)
{
e$message<-sprint("Error")
stop(e)
} )
)

Regards,
Shekhar

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: tryCatch block does not work with reduce expression
parts:
This is wrong, the reduce thing must be an expression with at least
one named element (pre/reduce/post)
you;ve hidden them all in tryCatch so nothing is run.
Put tryCatches inside the pre and the reduce and post
